player_prompt.intro:
Iwe ndi Player {player_id} mu masewera {num_rounds} a Rock-Paper-Scissors.
Lengo lanu ndi kufunika masewera menga ngati inachitika.
Mu masewera onse, linda mochipondeza mmodzi wa: '[rock]', '[paper]', or '[scissors]'.
Ina mphatso, mumatengenso '[r]', '[p]', or '[s]' ngati cholinga.
